using System;

namespace Example.Parsing
{
    // Sits above nothing: a blank line follows.

    /// <summary>Parses recipes with <see cref="Reader"/>.</summary>
    /// <remarks>Returns a <c>Recipe</c>.</remarks>
    [Serializable]
    public sealed class Parser
    {
        /// <summary>The source text.</summary>
        private readonly string source = "";

        // A plain comment on a field.
        private int count;

        /// <summary>Makes a parser.</summary>
        /// <param name="source">The text to read.</param>
        public Parser(string source) { }

        /// <summary>The parser's name.</summary>
        public string Name { get; set; }

        /// <summary>Runs the parser.</summary>
        /// <example>
        /// <code>
        /// new Parser("x").Run();
        /// </code>
        /// </example>
        [Obsolete]
        public int Run()
        {
            /// Not documentation: a statement follows it.
            var blocks = 0;
            return blocks; // a trailing comment
        }

        /// <summary>Raised when the parser stops.</summary>
        public event EventHandler Stopped;
    }

    /// <summary>The kinds of block.</summary>
    public enum Kind
    {
        /// <summary>Plain text.</summary>
        Text,
        Code,
    }

    /** <summary>A point.</summary> */
    public record Point(int X, int Y);
}
